fields.acceptance: Tests: go test -trimpath -p 2 -count=1 ./internal/model ./internal/check passes. A new TestAsIsSeedWhatIfFrom in internal/model, over a log with a landed base, two in-flight change sets where one depends on the other, one in-flight change set whose ops no longer apply and a duplicate handle, shows that AsIsSeed's Model and problems equal AsIs's, that ToBeFrom over its seed equals ToBe (model and problems), and that WhatIfFrom over its seed equals WhatIf (model and problems) for every in-flight change set. All of ToBeFrom and the WhatIfFrom calls run over one shared seed, and the results are compared only after every call has run, and the seed is compared with a fresh AsIsSeed after them: each must still be equal. A new TestWhatIfOnceMatches in internal/check, over the same shape of log plus an in-flight link whose ends its type does not allow and an in-flight node whose text refers to a node that does not exist, shows check's in-flight findings listed exactly. Failure case: an in-flight change set whose what-if has problems, a bad in-flight link and a broken in-flight text ref are each reported once, not twice. Profile, before any code change and again after: go build -trimpath -o $TMPDIR/rhiza-x ./cmd/rhiza, then in this repo's main checkout RHIZA_CPUPROFILE=$TMPDIR/check.prof $TMPDIR/rhiza-x check and go tool pprof -top -cum $TMPDIR/rhiza-x $TMPDIR/check.prof. The commit's Checks: block gives /usr/bin/time -f '%e s' for both builds, and the cumulative shares of store.ReadLog, changeset.FoldLog, model.WhatIf/WhatIfFrom, model.asIs and checker.render before and after. After the change, model.WhatIf and model.ToBe no longer appear under check.Run, and model.asIs is called once per check. Touches internal/model/seed.go, internal/check/check.go, internal/check/textrefs.go and their tests. Must not change what check reports, its order or its --json shape.
fields.statement: rhiza check builds the as-is view once, with model.AsIsSeed (internal/model/seed.go, new: the as-is Model, its problems and a model.Seed built in memory), and both the to-be view, with a new model.ToBeFrom(seed, sets) replacing checker.model's model.ToBe call (internal/check/check.go:378), and each in-flight change set's what-if, with model.WhatIfFrom, from that one seed; the in-flight problems pass (checker.model, :384), the in-flight links pass (checker.inFlightLinks, :456) and the text-ref pass (checker.textRefs, internal/check/textrefs.go:49, run from check.Run at :282) share those what-if views instead of each calling model.WhatIf. Seed.builder (internal/model/seed.go:120) copies each node's and link's value (its History and Fields) and aspects into the builder records, so building views from one seed never changes the seed or an earlier view
